Package edu.cnu.mdi.graphics

Class GraphicsUtils

java.lang.Object
edu.cnu.mdi.graphics.GraphicsUtils
public class GraphicsUtils extends Object
Static utility methods for general-purpose 2D graphics operations.

Graphics context

Every drawing method in this class accepts a Graphics2D context directly. The legacy Graphics parameter type has been removed throughout; no internal casts are performed.

Note for callers that override Component.paint(java.awt.Graphics): Java AWT declares paint(Graphics g) with a fixed signature. Inside that override, cast once at the entry point and pass the result to these utilities: 

 @Override
 public void paint(Graphics g) {
     Graphics2D g2 = (Graphics2D) g;
     GraphicsUtils.drawHighlightedRectangle(g2, rect);
 }

Stroke caching

BasicStroke objects are expensive to construct and are immutable. getStroke(float, LineStyle) caches every stroke it creates in strokes so that repeated calls with the same parameters return the same object without allocation.

Highlighted drawing

"Highlighted" shapes (rectangles, ovals, polylines, etc.) are drawn twice with complementary dashed strokes — dash1/dash2 or dash1_2/dash2_2 — in two alternating colors. The result is a marching-ants selection indicator. Default colors are highlightColor1 (red) and highlightColor2 (yellow).

    • getStroke

      public static BasicStroke getStroke(float lineWidth, LineStyle lineStyle)
      Return a cached BasicStroke for the given line width and style.

      The first call for any (width, style) combination creates and caches the stroke; subsequent calls return the cached instance. A width of zero is treated identically to a width of one.

      Supported styles and their dash patterns:

      • LineStyle.SOLID — no dash (round cap/join)
      • LineStyle.DASH — 10 on, 10 off
      • LineStyle.DOT_DASH — 4-4-10-4
      • LineStyle.DOT — 4 on, 4 off
      • LineStyle.DOUBLE_DASH — 10-4-10-10
      • LineStyle.LONG_DASH — 15 on, 15 off
      • LineStyle.LONG_DOT_DASH — 6-4-15-4
      Parameters:
      lineWidth - the desired stroke width in pixels
      lineStyle - the dash pattern style; must not be null
      Returns:
      a BasicStroke matching the requested parameters

      public static void drawEtchedText(Graphics2D g2, String text, int x, int y)

      The string is drawn twice: first in white at (x+1, y+1) to create a shadow, then in black at (x, y). This makes the text readable against any background color.

      public static void drawRotatedText(Graphics2D g2, String s, Font font, int x, int y, double angleDegrees)
      Draw a string at the given position, rotated by angleDegrees around its baseline anchor.

      If the angle is less than 0.5° (effectively zero) the text is drawn normally without any rotation transform.

    • drawRotatedText

      public static void drawRotatedText(Graphics2D g2, String s, Font font, int xo, int yo, int delX, int delY, double angleDegrees)
      Draw a string rotated around an anchor point with an additional unrotated offset applied before rotation.

      The offset (delX, delY) is first rotated by angleDegrees and then added to the anchor (xo, yo) to determine where the string baseline is drawn.

      If the angle is less than 0.5° (effectively zero) the text is drawn normally at (xo + delX, yo + delY) without any rotation transform, which avoids floating-point error in the identity case.

      Parameters:
      g2 - the graphics context
      s - the string to draw; must not be null
      font - the font to use
      xo - the x pixel coordinate of the rotation anchor
      yo - the y pixel coordinate of the rotation anchor
      delX - horizontal offset from the anchor, measured before rotation is applied
      delY - vertical offset from the anchor, measured before rotation is applied
      angleDegrees - the counter-clockwise rotation angle in degrees

    • pointOnLine

      public static boolean pointOnLine(int px, int py, int startx, int starty, int endx, int endy)
      Test whether a pixel point lies on a pixel line segment within the tolerance defined by SELECTRES.

      The test is performed in pixel space using a parametric projection. A point is considered "on" the line if:

      • The projection of the point onto the infinite line through the segment falls within the segment (t ∈ [0, 1]), and
      • The perpendicular distance from the point to the line is less than SELECTRES pixels.

      If the segment is nearly degenerate (both |Δx| and |Δy| are less than 2 pixels) the method returns false.

      Parameters:
      px - x coordinate of the point to test
      py - y coordinate of the point to test
      startx - x coordinate of the segment start
      starty - y coordinate of the segment start
      endx - x coordinate of the segment end
      endy - y coordinate of the segment end
      Returns:
      true if the point is within tolerance of the segment

    • colorToHex

      public static String colorToHex(Color color)
      Convert a Color to an 8-digit hex string in #rrggbbaa format.

      All four channels (red, green, blue, alpha) are included. Returns "#000000ff" (opaque black) if color is null.

      Parameters:
      color - the color to convert; may be null
      Returns:
      hex string in the form #rrggbbaa

    • colorFromHex

      public static Color colorFromHex(String hex)
      Parse a hex color string in common internet format.

      The string may be in any of these forms:

      • rrggbbaa — 8 hex digits, fully specified
      • rrggbb — 6 hex digits; alpha defaults to ff (fully opaque)
      • #rrggbbaa or #rrggbb — leading # is optional

      Strings shorter than 6 hex digits are zero-padded on the right. Returns Color.black if hex is null or cannot be parsed.

      Parameters:
      hex - the hex color string; may be null
      Returns:
      the corresponding Color, or Color.black on error
